Title: Azure Stream Analytics support for Visual Studio Code is in preview

Body.Content:
Use Azure Stream Analytics for Visual Studio Code to develop, manage, and test Stream Analytics jobs on Mac, Linux, and Windows. This enables easy development in a lightweight, cross-platform editor with bestin-class IntelliSense features and native support for source control. An NPM package will be provided for setting up CI/CD pipelines using Visual Studio Code Stream Analytics projects.

Learn more
